notes.text:
- **P2:** what you install is the prebuilt binary from the `datto-rmm-v0.1.10` release. GitHub's release attestation records each asset's SHA-256 against commit `e9c7c7e` (it matches the registry pin `6b867287…`), but there is no build-provenance attestation, so the binary can't be shown to be built from this source.
- **N1, N2, T4:** the hits are code comments and an example host in help text (`cli/internal/cli/doctor_verdict.go:79`, `cli/internal/cliutil/jwtshape.go:16`, `cli/internal/mcp/cobratree/shellout.go:285`, `cli/internal/cliutil/text.go:14`). Datto calls go only to `*-api.centrastage.net`.
- **D2:** tools run the project's own companion CLI binary directly (`exec.CommandContext`, no shell, `cobratree/shellout.go:287`); the other hits open a browser for sign-in. That is its design, not a shell or code evaluation.
- **C3 (confirmed):** `sync` copies the fleet (sites, devices, alerts, audits) into a SQLite store at `~/.local/share/<name>/data.db` (`cli/internal/cli/helpers.go:1910`), plus a response cache written with owner-only permissions (`cli/internal/cache/cache.go:48`). The maintainer documents the local fleet store.
- **T3 (confirmed), running jobs on devices:** `datto-rmm_execute` (`cli/internal/mcp/code_orch.go:43`) is always registered and calls any endpoint in its built-in list by `endpoint_id`, including `device.quickjob.create-quick-job` (runs a component on a device, `code_orch.go:366`), `device.site.move-device`, site/account variable and proxy changes, and `user.reset-api-keys` (`code_orch.go:656`). Because the endpoint is a parameter, a deny rule on the tool name can't separate reads from writes.
- **T2 (confirmed fail):** the matched `readOnlyIntent` (`cli/internal/client/client.go:422`) is an internal flag for the generator's test harness, and `mcp:read-only` is a hint annotation on generated tools (`cobratree/classify.go:20`); neither is a switch you can turn on. No environment setting disables writes; the README's advice is an API user with a read-only security level in Datto.
- **D1:** HTTP mode is opt-in (`--transport http` or `PP_MCP_TRANSPORT=http`), listens on `:7777`, all interfaces, with no authentication (`cmd/datto-rmm-mcp/main.go:23,52`), and uses the server's own Datto credentials. The default is stdio, which is how the registry runs it. Opt-in, so it fails D1 without the open-by-default cap.
- **T1:** tools are generated at runtime from the CLI's command tree, so the 5 found in the source understate the real number.
- **S3:** `golang.org/x/mod` and `golang.org/x/sys` versions with Go advisories.

- **P2:** `@wyre-ai/datto-rmm-mcp` is not on the public npm registry; the script read npm's "not found" reply as a package without provenance. Installed from the pinned commit, as for the other GitHub sources.
- **N2:** the hits are the function name `neutralizeClosingTag(` matching the `gtag(` pattern (`src/untrusted-content.ts:135,146`). No telemetry.
- **C2:** the flagged line prints a fixed error message; the code states the secret is never logged (`src/index.ts:80-90`).
- **D1:** stdio is the default (`src/index.ts:297`). HTTP mode refuses to start without `CONDUIT_S2S_SECRET` and checks the `X-Gateway-S2S` header on every request (`src/index.ts:87-99,172`); without a secret it only runs with `MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV=1`, and then only on 127.0.0.1.
- **Running jobs on devices:** `datto_run_quickjob` runs a component on one device with caller-supplied variables (`src/mcp-server.ts:620,1098`). Writes are limited to that and `datto_resolve_alert`; there is no read-only switch, but both names can be matched by a deny rule. Tool output is wrapped in a `<datto-data>` block marked as data, not instructions (`src/untrusted-content.ts`).
- **API client not read here:** the Datto calls are made by a separate package, `@wyre-ai/node-datto-rmm`, resolved from GitHub Packages (`package-lock.json:1946`), which needs a GitHub token even to install. Its code isn't part of this assessment. The regional `*-api.centrastage.net` hosts appear in `src/patches.ts:29-34`.
- **Hosting:** WYRE's Claude Code plugin points at WYRE's hosted gateway by default. This assessment is of running the source yourself. The copy under `WYRE-AI/msp-claude-plugins/msp-claude-plugins/mcp-servers/datto-rmm-mcp` is an older vendored snapshot of this repo.
- **S3:** the shipped lockfile pins versions with published advisories, including `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.31.0, `body-parser` and `fast-uri`.

- **Read-only switch:** `DATTO_MCP_READONLY=true` leaves out every tool in `DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS`, including `create-quick-job` (`src/security.ts:3-31`, `src/index.ts:34`).
- **Running jobs on devices:** with the switch off, `create-quick-job` runs a component on a device. It and nine other tools (`reset-api-keys`, `move-device`, `set-site-proxy`, variable deletes and others) require a `confirm` argument equal to the tool's name in capitals (`src/security.ts:26-28`). The model can fill that in itself, so it slows a mistaken call rather than requiring a person.
- **S2:** `prepare` runs the project's own TypeScript build (`npm run build`) when installed from git; it doesn't run when installed from npm. Published to npm with a provenance attestation.
- Runs over stdio only. Last changed May 2026, single maintainer.
- **S3:** the shipped lockfile pins versions with advisories, including `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.29.0 and `@hono/node-server`.

- **S1:** the lockfile is `pnpm-lock.yaml` at the monorepo root, outside the assessed folder. The script doesn't read pnpm lockfiles, so S3 couldn't be checked.
- **P2:** published to npm as `datto-rmm-mcp-server` 0.1.0 without a provenance attestation. Building from source needs the pnpm workspace, since the API client is the sibling package `datto-rmm-api` (`workspace:*`). That client talks only to the six `*-api.centrastage.net` hosts.
- **Running jobs on devices:** `create-quick-job` (`src/tools/index.ts:352`, a `PUT /v2/device/{deviceUid}/quickjob` in `src/tools/devices.ts:263`) runs a component on a device. There is no read-only switch; every write tool (15, including `move-device`, `update-site-proxy` and variable deletes) starts with a verb a deny rule can match.
- One release (v0.1.0, January 2026), single maintainer. A copy without the lockfile exists at `floriand-mspblue/datto-rmm-mcp-dev`; it isn't assessed separately.

- **C4, C1:** HTTP only; there is no stdio mode (`src/datto_rmm_mcp/__main__.py:41`). Datto keys aren't read from the environment: each request carries the caller's own key and secret in `X-Datto-Api-Key` / `X-Datto-Api-Secret` headers (`server.py:99-100`). It's built to sit behind MSPbots' gateway.
- **D1:** listens on all interfaces, port 8080 (`config.py:9-10`), but every `/mcp` request without both key headers gets a 401 (`server.py:102-117`); there is no shared credential to borrow.
- **Caller-chosen API host:** an `X-Datto-Api-Url` header, when sent, replaces the regional host with no check that it is a Datto host (`server.py:53-57`), and the key and secret go to that URL for the token exchange. Whoever runs the server can be made to send requests to any address it can reach.
- **Running jobs on devices:** `dattormm_run_component` runs a component on a device right away (`tools/jobs.py:27`). It refuses unless `confirm=true`, which the model sets itself; there is no read-only switch. Only six tools in all.
- **S3:** the lockfile pins `mcp` 1.29.1, `pyjwt` 2.13.0 and `certifi` versions with advisories.

- **P2:** `dattormm-mcp` is not on npm; the script read npm's "not found" reply as a package without provenance. Installed from the pinned commit.
- **D1:** stdio is the default. With `MCP_TRANSPORT=http` it calls `listen(port)` with no host, which listens on all interfaces, port 3000, and has no authentication (`src/index.ts:19-64`); anyone who can reach that port uses your Datto keys, including the job tool. The script missed it because no `0.0.0.0` appears in the call. Opt-in, so it fails D1 without the open-by-default cap.
- **Running jobs on devices:** `datto_run_quickjob` runs a component on a device. There is no read-only switch; all 15 write tools start with `datto_` followed by a verb a deny rule can match.
- One commit (July 2026), single contributor, no tags.

- **Monorepo:** one Go module with separate servers for Autotask, IT Glue, Datto RMM, Datto Backup/EDR/Network and others; the whole repo was read because they share `go.sum`. The Datto RMM binary (`cmd/datto-rmm-mcp/main.go`) loads only `pkg/dattormm`, `pkg/config` and `pkg/mcputil`, and runs over stdio only.
- **N1:** the other hosts belong to the other servers. `pkg/dattormm/client.go:25-30` lists only the six `*-api.centrastage.net` hosts; `https://logiphys.de` is a text field in the server-info tool's output, not a request (`pkg/mcputil/serverinfo.go:37`).
- **C2:** the flagged lines (IT Glue server) log the tool name and error, not a secret.
- **T2:** the two names flagged (`get_activity_log`, `list_alerts_archive`) are reads in other servers. The Datto RMM server has no read-only switch, but all its write tools start with a verb.
- **Running jobs on devices:** `create_quick_job` runs a component on a device (`pkg/dattormm/tools_devices.go:185`), marked destructive, with no confirmation step or switch. Other writes include `move_device`, `update_site_proxy` and variable create/delete.
- `DATTO_BASE_URL` can replace the regional host.

- **Monorepo:** one Python package with separate stdio servers for Datto RMM, CrowdStrike, Mimecast, ThreatLocker, Portnox, AssetPanda and ClouDNS. The other hosts belong to those servers; the Datto RMM server's client talks only to `*-api.centrastage.net` (`src/msp_mcp/datto/client.py:17`).
- **Writes off by default:** Datto write tools refuse unless `MSP_MCP_DATTO_WRITES=1` is set (`src/msp_mcp/core/guard.py:43-52`). Every write attempt, allowed or refused, is appended to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MSP-MCP\audit.log` (action and target, no credentials). That log is the C3 hit; it isn't a data cache.
- **Running jobs on devices:** `run_quick_job` and `run_quick_job_many` run a component on one or many devices once writes are on (`datto/server.py:430,479`). The many-device version defaults to a dry run and refuses more than 25 devices unless `max_devices` is raised.
- **C1, D2:** credentials don't come from environment variables but from a DPAPI-encrypted file in the user's profile, or from a `Credential.ps1` that it runs with `powershell.exe` (`core/credentials.py:26-32,78`). That is a fixed command with the credential name passed in an environment variable; no model input reaches it. The script you dot-source isn't part of the repo.
- No licence (caps the score). No tags.

- **What it is:** a hosted, multi-user Autotask PSA server with a web console that also has 55 Datto RMM tools (`docs/DATTO-RMM.md`). It needs PostgreSQL and Microsoft Entra ID sign-in, and has no stdio mode (C4).
- **Licence:** "All rights reserved"; no right to copy or deploy is granted (`LICENSE`), which caps the score.
- **P2:** the package name `rarity-autotask-mcp` is not on npm; the script read npm's "not found" reply as a package without provenance.
- **D1:** listens on all interfaces, but `/mcp` requires an Entra ID bearer token on every request (`apps/server/src/app.ts:225-227`).
- **C3 (confirmed):** state lives in PostgreSQL, including the Datto key and secret, which are stored encrypted (`docs/DATTO-RMM.md`); fixture mode writes demo tokens to `work/demo-credentials.json` (`apps/server/src/main.ts:15`).
- **N1:** the other hosts are its other integrations (Autotask, IT Glue, Microsoft Graph and sign-in).
- **Running jobs on devices:** `rmm_quickjob_run` only runs components an administrator approved in the console, with fixed variable values the model can't change, for users granted `rmm.execute` (`packages/rmm/src/service.ts:29,40`).
- **T1:** the RMM tools are declared in a form the script doesn't read, so the 10 tools found are mostly Autotask.
- **T4:** the hit is a code comment.
- **S3:** the lockfile pins `@modelcontextprotocol/server` 2.0.0 and `zod` versions with advisories.
